headline: Growth holds steady as margins widen and buybacks accelerate
summary_short: Paylocity's fiscal Q4 2026 total revenue rose 11.0% y/y to $444.7 million and non-GAAP diluted EPS grew 17.9% y/y to $1.84, while the company repurchased $398.1 million of stock and cut long-term debt 50.0% y/y to $81.3 million during the fiscal year.
summary_long: Q4 FY2026 (quarter ended June 30, 2026) recurring & other revenue rose 12.4% y/y to $415.6M; total revenue rose 11.0% y/y to $444.7M. GAAP net income grew 24.1% y/y to $60.3M ($1.12 diluted EPS, +30.2% y/y); non-GAAP diluted EPS was $1.84 (+17.9% y/y) on buyback-driven share reduction. Adjusted EBITDA rose 11.3% y/y to $145.5M. FY2026: $398.1M repurchased, $81.3M debt repaid, leaving debt at $81.3M (-50.0% y/y) and cash at $271.9M (-9.3% q/q). Equity rose 3.4% q/q to $1,221.4M. FY2026 free cash flow was $427.8M (24.2% margin) vs 21.5% in FY2025. Guidance: Q1 FY2027 total revenue $439.5-444.5M, FY2027 total revenue $1.880-1.895B.

drivers.explanation: Company-disclosed: CEO cited durable growth from continued expansion of average revenue per client plus a roughly 7% increase in client base, alongside rising profitability and the Grayscale acquisition and Ignite AI product launch.
Company-disclosed: growth attributed to average-revenue-per-client expansion and roughly 7% client-base growth, per the CEO's remarks in the release.
Company-disclosed: CEO attributed the gain to revenue growth combined with increasing profitability across the organization; not broken out by specific cost line in the release.
Derived-arithmetic: non-GAAP net income rose ~13.0% y/y this quarter while diluted weighted-average shares fell ~4.1% y/y (buyback-driven), together producing the 17.9% EPS gain.
Company-disclosed: the release states the credit-facility balance was reduced through repayment during fiscal 2026, taking long-term debt to $81.3 million.
Not explicitly reconciled in the release, but consistent with FY2026 cash outflows of $398.1M in buybacks and $81.3M in debt repayment against $533.3M of operating cash flow.
Not explained in the release; q/q rise is consistent with retained-earnings growth from net income outpacing buyback-driven equity reduction.
